title.zh: 卷三百十四 列傳第七十三 Fan Zhongyan and son: Chunyou, Chun Li, Chun Cui, Fan Chunren and son: Zhengping
title.raw: 卷三百十四 列傳第七十三 Fan Zhongyan and son: Chunyou, Chun Li, Chun Cui, Fan Chunren and son: Zhengping Volume 314 Biographies 73:

sentences.zh: 范仲淹

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan

sentences.zh: 范仲淹，字希文，唐宰相履冰之後。

translations.literal: Fan Zhongyan, courtesy name Xiwen, was a descendant of the Tang chancellor Fan Lübing.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongyan, styled Xiwen, was descended from Fan Lübing, a chancellor of the Tang.

sentences.zh: 其先邠州人也，後徙家江南，遂為蘇州吳縣人。

translations.literal: His ancestors were people of Bin Prefecture; later they moved their household to the south of the Yangtze, and thus became people of Wuxian in Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His forebears were from Bin Prefecture; the family later moved south of the Yangtze and settled as natives of Wuxian in Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 仲淹二歲而孤，母更適長山朱氏，從其姓，名說。

translations.literal: Zhongyan was orphaned at age two; his mother remarried into the Zhu clan of Changshan, and he took their surname, being named Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan lost his father when he was two. His mother remarried into the Zhu family of Changshan, and he took their surname and the name Shuo.

sentences.zh: 少有志操，既長，知其世家，乃感泣辭母，去之應天府，依戚同文學。

translations.literal: In youth he had lofty resolve and integrity; once grown, learning of his family's distinguished lineage, he wept with emotion, took leave of his mother, went to Yingtian Prefecture, and studied under Qi Tongwen.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood he showed high purpose and moral fiber. When he came of age and learned of his family's eminent pedigree, he wept, bade his mother farewell, went to Yingtian Prefecture, and studied under Qi Tongwen.

sentences.zh: 晝夜不息，冬月憊甚，以水沃面；

translations.literal: Day and night he did not cease; in the winter months when utterly exhausted, he would pour water on his face.
translations.idiomatic: He studied day and night without rest. In the depths of winter, when he was utterly worn out, he would splash water on his face to stay awake.

sentences.zh: 食不給，至以糜粥繼之，人不能堪，仲淹不苦也。

translations.literal: When food was insufficient he would subsist on thin gruel; others could not endure it, but Zhongyan did not find it hard.
translations.idiomatic: When food ran short he lived on thin gruel. Others could not bear it, but Zhongyan never complained.

sentences.zh: 舉進士第，為廣德軍司理參軍，迎其母歸養。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was appointed assistant judicial officer of the Guangde Army; he brought his mother home to provide for her.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examinations, was appointed assistant magistrate for law at the Guangde Army, and brought his mother home to support her.

sentences.zh: 改集慶軍節度推官，始還姓，更其名。

translations.literal: He was transferred to judicial commissioner under the Jiqing Army military commissioner; only then did he restore his original surname and change his given name.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to judicial commissioner under the Jiqing Army military commissioner, at which point he reclaimed his family surname and changed his given name.

sentences.zh: 監泰州西溪鹽稅，遷大理寺丞，徙監楚州糧料院，母喪去官。

translations.literal: He supervised salt tax at Xixi in Taizhou, was promoted to assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, transferred to supervise the grain supply depot in Chuzhou, and left office on his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised salt tax at Xixi in Taizhou, was promoted to assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, then transferred to oversee the grain depot in Chuzhou; he left office when his mother died.

sentences.zh: 晏殊知應天府，聞仲淹名，召寘府學。

translations.literal: When Yan Shu was prefect of Yingtian Prefecture, hearing Zhongyan's reputation, he summoned him and placed him in the prefectural school.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan Shu served as prefect of Yingtian Prefecture, he heard of Zhongyan's reputation, summoned him, and enrolled him in the prefectural school.

sentences.zh: 上書請擇郡守，舉縣令，斥游惰，去冗僭，慎選舉，撫將帥，凡萬餘言。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial requesting the selection of prefectural administrators, the promotion of county magistrates, the expulsion of the idle and negligent, the removal of redundant and overstepping staff, careful conduct of examinations and appointments, and proper nurturing of generals and commanders—in all more than ten thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial calling for the careful selection of prefects and county magistrates, the dismissal of the idle and negligent, the elimination of redundant and overreaching posts, stricter standards in examinations and appointments, and better treatment of generals and commanders—more than ten thousand words in all.

sentences.zh: 服除，以殊薦，為秘閣校理。

translations.literal: When his mourning period ended, on Yan Shu's recommendation he was appointed collator in the Secret Repository.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning period ended, Yan Shu recommended him, and he was appointed collator in the Secret Repository.

sentences.zh: 仲淹泛通《六經》，長於《易》，學者多從質問，為執經講解，亡所倦。

translations.literal: Zhongyan had broad mastery of the Six Classics and excelled in the Book of Changes; many scholars came to question him, and he would lecture on the classics and explain them, never wearying.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan had wide command of the Six Classics and was especially skilled in the Book of Changes. Many scholars came to consult him; he would hold the classics and lecture, never tiring of it.

sentences.zh: 嘗推其奉以食四方游士，諸子至易衣而出，仲淹晏如也。

translations.literal: He once diverted his official salary to feed traveling scholars from all quarters; his sons would even change clothes before going out, yet Zhongyan remained entirely at ease.
translations.idiomatic: He often used his salary to feed traveling scholars from all directions. His sons would even change clothes before going out so as not to wear their good ones, yet Zhongyan remained perfectly content.

sentences.zh: 每感激論天下事，奮不顧身，一時士大夫矯厲尚風節，自仲淹倡之。

translations.literal: Whenever he spoke with passion about affairs under Heaven, he set aside concern for his own safety; at that time the gentry's cultivation of principled conduct began with Zhongyan's example.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he spoke passionately about affairs of state, he forgot all concern for himself. The gentry's renewed esteem for integrity and moral courage at that time began with Zhongyan's example.

sentences.zh: 天聖七年，章獻太后將以冬至受朝，天子率百官上壽。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tiansheng, Empress Dowager Zhangxian planned to receive court on the winter solstice, with the emperor leading all officials to offer birthday congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tiansheng, Empress Dowager Zhangxian planned to hold court on the winter solstice, with the emperor leading all officials to offer her birthday congratulations.

sentences.zh: 仲淹極言之，且曰：「奉親於內，自有家人禮，顧與百官同列，南面而朝之，不可為後世法。」

translations.literal: Zhongyan spoke against this forcefully, saying: 'In attending to one's parent within the inner quarters, one has the ritual propriety of a household. Yet to stand in the same ranks as all officials and bow toward her in audience—this cannot become a precedent for posterity.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan spoke against this in the strongest terms, saying: 'Serving a parent within the inner palace follows the etiquette of a household. To stand in the same ranks as all officials and bow toward her in audience would set a precedent that posterity must not follow.'

sentences.zh: 且上疏請太后還政，不報。

translations.literal: He also submitted a memorial requesting the empress dowager return governmental power, but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial asking the empress dowager to return governmental authority, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 尋通判河中府，徙陳州。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed acting prefect of Hezhong Prefecture, then transferred to Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed acting prefect of Hezhong Prefecture, then transferred to Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時方建太一宮及洪福院，市材木陝西。

translations.literal: At that time the T'ai-yi Palace and Hongfu Cloister were being built, and timber was being purchased in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the T'ai-yi Palace and Hongfu Cloister were under construction, and timber was being purchased in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 仲淹言：「昭應、壽寧，天戒不遠。

translations.literal: Zhongyan said: 'The calamities at Zhaoying and Shouning showed that Heaven's warnings are not far off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan said: 'The disasters at Zhaoying and Shouning showed that Heaven's warnings are never far away.

sentences.zh: 今又侈土木，破民產，非所以順人心、合天意也。

translations.literal: Now again to lavish resources on buildings and works, destroying the people's livelihood—this is not the way to accord with the people's hearts or Heaven's will.
translations.idiomatic: Now to lavish resources on construction again, ruining the people's livelihood—this is no way to win hearts or accord with Heaven's will.

sentences.zh: 宜罷修寺觀，減常歲市木之數，以蠲除積負。」

translations.literal: Construction of temples and monasteries should be halted, and the regular annual quota for purchasing timber should be reduced, so as to remit accumulated burdens.'
translations.idiomatic: Construction of temples and monasteries should be halted, and the annual quota for timber purchases reduced, so that accumulated burdens on the people may be lifted.'

sentences.zh: 又言：「恩幸多以內降除官，非太平之政。」

translations.literal: He also said: 'Favored courtiers often receive appointments through private edicts from the palace, which is not policy fit for a time of great peace.'
translations.idiomatic: He also said: 'Favored intimates are too often appointed by private edicts from within the palace—this is not governance fit for an age of peace.'

sentences.zh: 事雖不行，仁宗以為忠。

translations.literal: Though his proposals were not adopted, Emperor Renzong regarded him as loyal.
translations.idiomatic: Though his proposals were not adopted, Emperor Renzong considered him loyal.

sentences.zh: 太后崩，召為右司諫。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager died, he was summoned as Right Remonstrance in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager died, he was summoned to serve as Right Remonstrance in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 言事者多暴太后時事，仲淹曰：「太后受遺先帝，調護陛下者十餘年，宜掩其小故，以全后德。」

translations.literal: Many who spoke on policy harshly exposed affairs from the empress dowager's regency. Zhongyan said: 'The empress dowager received the late emperor's testamentary charge and guided and protected Your Majesty for more than ten years. Her minor faults should be covered so as to preserve the empress dowager's virtue in full.'
translations.idiomatic: Many who spoke on policy harshly aired affairs from the empress dowager's regency. Zhongyan said: 'The empress dowager received the late emperor's dying charge and guided and protected Your Majesty for more than ten years. Her minor faults should be overlooked so that her virtue may stand complete.'

sentences.zh: 帝為詔中外，毋輒論太后時事。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict to court and commoners alike not to discuss affairs of the empress dowager's regency at will.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict to court and country alike forbidding discussion of affairs from the empress dowager's regency.

sentences.zh: 初，太后遺誥乙太妃楊氏為皇太后，參決軍國事。

translations.literal: Initially the empress dowager's testamentary edict had invested the imperial concubine Yang with the title of empress dowager to participate in deciding military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the empress dowager's testamentary edict had invested the imperial consort Yang as empress dowager with authority to participate in military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 仲淹曰：「太后，母號也，自古無因保育而代立者。

translations.literal: Zhongyan said: ''Empress dowager' is a title for a mother. Since antiquity none has been installed merely for having nursed and raised [the emperor].
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan said: ''Empress dowager' is a title reserved for a mother. Since antiquity no one has been raised to that rank merely for having nursed and raised the emperor.

sentences.zh: 今一太后崩，又立一太后，天下且疑陛下不可一日無母后之助矣。」

translations.literal: Now that one empress dowager has died, yet another empress dowager is to be installed—the realm will suspect that Your Majesty cannot go a single day without a empress dowager's assistance.'
translations.idiomatic: Now that one empress dowager has died, yet another is to be installed—the realm will suspect that Your Majesty cannot govern for a single day without a empress dowager's help.'

sentences.zh: 歲大蝗旱，江、淮、京東滋甚。

translations.literal: That year there was severe locust plague and drought; the Yangzi-Huai and He-dong regions were hit hardest.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts and drought struck severely; the Yangzi-Huai and He-dong regions suffered most.

sentences.zh: 仲淹請遣使循行，未報。

translations.literal: Zhongyan requested that envoys be dispatched to inspect the affected areas, but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan requested that envoys be sent to tour the affected regions, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 乃請間曰：「宮掖中半日不食，當何如？」

translations.literal: He then requested a private audience, saying: 'If those within the palace went half a day without food, what then?'
translations.idiomatic: He then requested a private audience and asked: 'If those within the palace went half a day without food, what would that be like?'

sentences.zh: 帝側然，乃命仲淹安撫江、淮，所至開倉振之，且禁民淫祀，奏蠲廬舒折役茶、江東丁口鹽錢，且條上救弊十事。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved, and ordered Zhongyan to pacify and comfort the Jiang and Huai regions. Wherever he went he opened granaries to relieve the people; he also prohibited wasteful popular sacrifices. He memorialized remission of the Lu-Shu corvée tea tax and the Jiang-dong head tax on salt, and submitted ten items for remedying abuses.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved and ordered Zhongyan to pacify the Jiang and Huai regions. Wherever he went he opened granaries to relieve the people and prohibited extravagant popular sacrifices. He memorialized remission of the Lu-Shu corvée tea tax and the Jiang-dong head tax on salt, and submitted ten proposals for remedying abuses.

sentences.zh: 會郭皇后廢，率諫官、御史伏閣爭之，不能得。

translations.literal: When Empress Guo was deposed, he led remonstrating officials and censorial commissioners in kneeling at the palace gate to protest, but could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Guo was deposed, he led remonstrating officials and censorial commissioners in kneeling at the palace gate to protest, but could not prevail.

sentences.zh: 明日，將留百官揖宰相廷爭，方至待漏院，有詔出知睦州。

translations.literal: The next day he intended to detain all officials to bow before the chief councilor and argue in court—but before he reached the waiting court, an edict was issued appointing him prefect of Mu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he planned to keep all officials at court to bow before the chief councilor and argue the matter—but before he reached the waiting court, an edict arrived appointing him prefect of Mu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，徙蘇州。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was transferred to Suzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was transferred to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 州大水，民田不得耕，仲淹疏五河，導太湖注之海，募人興作，未就，尋徙明州，轉運使奏留仲淹以畢其役，許之。

translations.literal: A great flood struck the prefecture; the people's fields could not be tilled. Zhongyan dredged five waterways to channel Lake Tai into the sea and hired labor for the project. Before it was finished he was soon transferred to Ming Prefecture, but the transport commissioner memorialized to retain Zhongyan until the work was completed, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: A great flood struck the prefecture and the people's fields could not be tilled. Zhongyan dredged five waterways to channel Lake Tai into the sea and hired labor for the project. Before the work was finished he was transferred to Ming Prefecture, but the transport commissioner memorialized to keep Zhongyan until the project was complete, and this was granted.

sentences.zh: 拜尚書禮部員外郎、天章閣待制，召還，判國子監，遷吏部員外郎、權知開封府。

translations.literal: He was appointed Assistant Director in the Ministry of Rites and Gentleman Consultant at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations, recalled to the capital, given charge of the Directorate of Education, promoted to Assistant Director in the Ministry of Personnel and acting prefect of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Assistant Director in the Ministry of Rites and Gentleman Consultant at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations, recalled to the capital, put in charge of the Directorate of Education, then promoted to Assistant Director in the Ministry of Personnel and acting prefect of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 時呂夷簡執政，進用者多出其門。

translations.literal: At that time Lü Yijian held power; many of those promoted had come from his faction.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Lü Yijian held power, and most of those promoted came from his circle.

sentences.zh: 仲淹上《百官圖》，指其次第曰：「如此為序遷，如此為不次，如此則公，如此則私。

translations.literal: Zhongyan submitted an 'Officials' Chart' pointing to each rank in order, saying: 'This is orderly promotion; this is extraordinary promotion; this serves the public; this serves private interest.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan submitted an 'Officials' Chart' and, pointing to each rank in order, said: 'This is regular promotion; this is extraordinary promotion; this serves the public good; this serves private interest.

sentences.zh: 況進退近臣，凡超格者，不宜全委之宰相。」

translations.literal: Moreover, when promoting or demoting close ministers—every case of advancement beyond regular rank—the chief councilor ought not to be given sole control.'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when promoting or demoting close ministers—whenever advancement goes beyond regular rank—the chief councilor should not be given sole discretion.'

sentences.zh: 夷簡不悅。

translations.literal: Yijian was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Yijian was displeased.

sentences.zh: 他日，論建都之事，仲淹曰：「洛陽險固，而汴為四戰之地，太平宜居汴，即有事必居洛陽。

translations.literal: On another day, in discussion of moving the capital, Zhongyan said: 'Luoyang is naturally fortified, whereas Bian [Kaifeng] is terrain for fighting on four fronts. In times of peace one should reside at Bian; should trouble arise one must move to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On another occasion, discussing the choice of capital, Zhongyan said: 'Luoyang is naturally fortified, whereas Bian is ground for fighting on four fronts. In peace one should reside at Bian; should trouble arise one must move to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 當漸廣儲蓄，繕宮室。」

translations.literal: Storage should be gradually expanded and palaces repaired.'
translations.idiomatic: Stores should be gradually expanded and palaces repaired there.'

sentences.zh: 帝問夷簡，夷簡曰：「此仲淹迂闊之論也。」

translations.literal: The emperor asked Yijian, who said: 'This is Zhongyan's impractical, narrow-minded talk.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Yijian, who said: 'This is Zhongyan's impractical, wide-of-the-mark talk.'

sentences.zh: 仲淹乃為四論以獻，大抵譏切時政。

translations.literal: Zhongyan then composed four memorial essays and presented them, largely criticizing current policy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan then composed four memorial essays and presented them, largely criticizing current policy.

sentences.zh: 且曰：「漢成帝信張禹，不疑舅家，故有新莽之禍。

translations.literal: And he said: 'Emperor Cheng of Han trusted Zhang Yu and did not suspect his wife's family, and thus arose the disaster of Wang Mang.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: 'Emperor Cheng of Han trusted Zhang Yu and did not suspect his wife's family, and thus arose the disaster of Wang Mang.

sentences.zh: 臣恐今日亦有張禹，壞陛下家法。」

translations.literal: I fear that today too there may be a Zhang Yu, undermining Your Majesty's family discipline.'
translations.idiomatic: I fear that today too there may be a Zhang Yu undermining Your Majesty's household discipline.'

sentences.zh: 夷簡怒訴曰：「仲淹離間陛下君臣，所引用，皆朋黨也。」

translations.literal: Yijian angrily complained, saying: 'Zhongyan is driving a wedge between Your Majesty and your ministers. All those he recommends are clique members.'
translations.idiomatic: Yijian angrily complained: 'Zhongyan is driving a wedge between Your Majesty and your ministers. Everyone he recommends belongs to a clique.'

sentences.zh: 仲淹對益切，由是罷知饒州。

translations.literal: Zhongyan's replies grew sharper, and on this account he was dismissed and made prefect of Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan's replies grew sharper still, and on this account he was dismissed and made prefect of Rao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史韓瀆希宰相旨，請書仲淹朋黨，揭之朝堂。

translations.literal: Palace Censor Han Du, eager to please the chief councilor, requested that Zhongyan's clique be written out and posted in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Censor Han Du, eager to please the chief councilor, requested that Zhongyan's clique be written out and posted in the court hall.

sentences.zh: 於是秘書丞余靖上言曰：「仲淹以一言忤宰相，遽加貶竄，況前所言者在陛下母子夫婦之間乎？

translations.literal: Thereupon Secretariat Assistant Yu Jing memorialized: 'Zhongyan, for a single word that offended the chief councilor, was suddenly demoted and banished—and what he had spoken of before concerned matters between Your Majesty and your mother and between husband and wife!
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Secretariat Assistant Yu Jing memorialized: 'Zhongyan, for a single word that offended the chief councilor, was suddenly demoted and banished—yet what he had spoken of before concerned matters between Your Majesty and your mother, and between husband and wife!

sentences.zh: 陛下既優容之矣，臣請追改前命。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty has already treated him leniently; I request that the previous order be withdrawn and revised.'
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has already treated him leniently; I ask that the previous order be withdrawn and revised.'

sentences.zh: 太子中允尹洙自訟與仲淹師友，且嘗薦己，願從降黜。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Aide Yin Shu pled on his own behalf that he was Zhongyan's teacher and friend and had even recommended himself, and wished to share the demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Aide Yin Shu pleaded on his own behalf that he was Zhongyan's teacher and friend and had even recommended himself, and wished to share the demotion.

sentences.zh: 館閣校勘歐陽修以高若訥在諫官，坐視而不言，移書責之。

translations.literal: Archive collator Ouyang Xiu, because Gao Ruonè sat as remonstrator yet watched without speaking, sent him a letter reproaching him.
translations.idiomatic: Archive collator Ouyang Xiu, because Gao Ruonè held a remonstrating post yet watched without speaking, sent him a letter of reproach.

sentences.zh: 由是，三人者偕坐貶。

translations.literal: On this account all three were likewise punished with demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On this account all three were likewise demoted.

sentences.zh: 明年，夷簡亦罷，自是朋黨之論興矣。

translations.literal: The next year Yijian was also dismissed, and from this time talk of cliques arose.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Yijian was also dismissed, and from that time talk of factions arose.

sentences.zh: 仲淹既去，士大夫為論薦者不已。

translations.literal: After Zhongyan departed, the gentry continued endlessly to recommend and discuss him.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhongyan departed, the gentry never ceased recommending and speaking on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 仁宗謂宰相張士遜曰：「向貶仲淹，為其密請建立皇太弟故也。

translations.literal: Renzong said to Chief Councilor Zhang Shisun: 'The earlier demotion of Zhongyan was because he secretly requested the establishment of a younger imperial brother as heir.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong said to Chief Councilor Zhang Shisun: 'The earlier demotion of Zhongyan was because he had secretly requested the establishment of a younger imperial brother as heir.

sentences.zh: 今朋黨稱薦如此，奈何？」

translations.literal: Yet now cliques praise and recommend him in this fashion—what is to be done?'
translations.idiomatic: Yet now factions praise and recommend him in this way—what is to be done?'

sentences.zh: 再下詔戒敕。

translations.literal: He issued edicts of warning again.
translations.idiomatic: He issued edicts of warning again.

sentences.zh: 仲淹在饒州歲餘，徙潤州，又徙越州。

translations.literal: After more than a year at Rao Prefecture, Zhongyan was transferred to Run Prefecture, then again to Yue Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year at Rao Prefecture, Zhongyan was transferred to Run Prefecture, then again to Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元昊反，召為天章閣待制、知永興軍，改陝西都轉運使。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao rebelled, Zhongyan was summoned as Gentleman Consultant at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of the Yongxing Army; then appointed transport commissioner for Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao rebelled, Zhongyan was summoned as Gentleman Consultant at the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of the Yongxing Army, then appointed transport commissioner for Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 會夏竦為陝西經略安撫、招討使，進仲淹龍圖閣直學士以副之。

translations.literal: When Xia Song became pacification and recruitment commissioner for Shaanxi, Zhongyan was promoted to Academician Expositor in Direct Attendance at the Hall of Dragon Manifestations as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: When Xia Song became pacification and recruitment commissioner for Shaanxi, Zhongyan was promoted to Academician Expositor in Direct Attendance at the Hall of Dragon Manifestations to serve as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 夷簡再入相，帝諭仲淹使釋前憾。

translations.literal: Yijian returned to power a second time; the emperor instructed Zhongyan to release past resentments.
translations.idiomatic: When Yijian returned to power a second time, the emperor instructed Zhongyan to set aside past resentments.

sentences.zh: 仲淹頓首謝曰：「臣鄉論蓋國家事，于夷簡無憾也。」

translations.literal: Zhongyan bowed and said: 'My arguments in court concerned affairs of state; toward Yijian I bear no resentment.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan bowed and said: 'My arguments in court concerned affairs of state; toward Yijian I bear no personal resentment.'

sentences.zh: 延州諸砦多失守，仲淹自請行，遷戶部郎中兼知延州。

translations.literal: Many fortresses in the Yan Prefecture sector had fallen. Zhongyan volunteered to go himself and was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Revenue while also acting prefect of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Many fortresses in the Yan Prefecture sector had fallen. Zhongyan volunteered to go in person and was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Revenue while also serving as acting prefect of Yan.

sentences.zh: 先是，詔分邊兵：總管領萬人，鈐轄領五千人，都監領三千人。

translations.literal: Previously an edict had divided border troops: the supreme commander led ten thousand men, the controller five thousand, the superintendent three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Previously an edict had divided border troops: the supreme commander led ten thousand men, the controller five thousand, and the superintendent three thousand.

sentences.zh: 寇至禦之，則官卑者先出。

translations.literal: When bandits arrived to resist them, the officer of lower rank went out first.
translations.idiomatic: When enemies came and troops went out to meet them, the officer of lower rank went out first.

sentences.zh: 仲淹曰：「將不擇人，以官為先後，取敗之道也。」

translations.literal: Zhongyan said: 'If generals are not chosen for ability but precedence is given to office rank, that is the path to defeat.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan said: 'If generals are not chosen for ability but precedence is given to office rank, that is the path to defeat.'

sentences.zh: 於是大閱州兵，得萬八千人，分為六，各將三千人，分部教之，量賊眾寡，使更出禦賊。

translations.literal: Thereupon he conducted a major review of prefectural troops, obtaining eighteen thousand men; he divided them into six divisions of three thousand each under commanders, trained them by section, and according to the enemy's numbers had them rotate in going out to meet the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he conducted a major review of prefectural troops and obtained eighteen thousand men. He divided them into six divisions of three thousand each under commanders, trained them by section, and according to the enemy's strength had them rotate in going out to meet them.

sentences.zh: 時塞門、承平諸砦既廢，用種世衡策，城青澗以據賊沖，大興營田，且聽民得互市，以通有無。

translations.literal: At that time the Saimen and Chengping fortresses had already been abandoned. Adopting Zhong Shihheng's plan, he fortified Qingjian to block the enemy's route, greatly developed military colonies, and also permitted the people to engage in mutual markets to circulate goods.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Saimen and Chengping fortresses had already been abandoned. Adopting Zhong Shihheng's plan, he fortified Qingjian to block the enemy's route of advance, greatly expanded military colonies, and also allowed the people to trade across the border so that goods could circulate.

sentences.zh: 又以民遠輸勞苦，請建鄜城為軍，以河中、同、華中下戶稅租就輸之。

translations.literal: Because the people found long-distance transport of provisions burdensome, he requested that a military settlement be established at Fucheng so that households in lower tax brackets from Hezhong, Tong, and Huazhong could deliver their tax grain there.
translations.idiomatic: Because long-distance transport of provisions burdened the people, he requested that a military settlement be established at Fucheng so that lower-bracket households in Hezhong, Tong, and Huazhong could deliver their tax grain there.

sentences.zh: 春夏徙兵就食，可省糴十之三，他所減不與。

translations.literal: In spring and summer troops could move there for rations, saving thirty percent of purchased grain; reductions elsewhere were not comparable.
translations.idiomatic: In spring and summer troops could move there for rations, saving thirty percent of purchased grain—a saving unmatched elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 詔以為康定軍。

translations.literal: An edict established this as the Kangding Army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established this as the Kangding Army.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，詔諸路入討，仲淹曰：「正月塞外大寒，我師暴露，不如俟春深入，賊馬瘦人饑，勢易制也。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year an edict ordered all routes to launch punitive campaigns. Zhongyan said: 'In the first month the cold beyond the passes is severe; our armies exposed in the open—it is better to wait until spring for a deep advance, when the enemy's horses are lean and men hungry and their situation easy to control.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year an edict ordered all routes to launch punitive campaigns. Zhongyan said: 'In the first month the cold beyond the passes is severe and our armies would be exposed in the open. It is better to wait until spring for a deep advance, when the enemy's horses are lean and men hungry and their situation easier to control.

sentences.zh: 況邊備漸修，師出有紀，賊雖猖獗，固已懾其氣矣。

translations.literal: Moreover border defenses are being gradually improved and campaigns are conducted with discipline; though the enemy is rampant, they are already cowed in spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover border defenses are being gradually improved and campaigns are conducted with discipline; though the enemy is rampant, their spirit is already cowed.

sentences.zh: 鄜、延密邇靈、夏，西羌必由之地也。

translations.literal: Fu and Yan lie close to Ling and Xia—the Western Qiang must pass through there.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and Yan lie close to Ling and Xia—the Western Qiang must pass through there.

sentences.zh: 第按兵不動，以觀其釁，許臣稍以恩信招來之。

translations.literal: Simply hold the army in place and watch for provocations; allow me gradually to win them over with favor and trust.
translations.idiomatic: Simply hold the army in place and watch for provocations; allow me gradually to win them over with favor and trust.

sentences.zh: 不然，情意阻絕，臣恐偃兵無期矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise, with goodwill blocked off, I fear there will be no end to the cessation of arms.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, with goodwill cut off, I fear there will be no end in sight to the cessation of arms.

sentences.zh: 若臣策不效，當舉兵先取綏、宥，據要害，屯兵營田，為持久計，則茶山、橫山之民，必挈族來歸矣。

translations.literal: If my plan fails, I should raise troops first to take Sui and You, hold the strategic points, station troops and develop military colonies as a long-term plan—then the people of Chashan and Hengshan will surely bring their clans to submit.
translations.idiomatic: If my plan fails, I should raise troops first to take Sui and You, hold the strategic points, station troops and develop military colonies as a long-term plan—then the people of Chashan and Hengshan will surely bring their clans to submit.

sentences.zh: 拓疆禦寇，策之上也。」

translations.literal: Expanding territory and repelling enemies is the highest strategy.'
translations.idiomatic: Expanding territory and repelling enemies is the highest strategy.'

sentences.zh: 帝皆用其議。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted all his proposals.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted all his proposals.

sentences.zh: 仲淹又請修承平、永平等砦，稍招還流亡，定堡障，通斥候，城十二砦，於是羌漢之民，相踵歸業。

translations.literal: Zhongyan also requested repair of the Chengping and Yongping fortresses and gradually recalled exiles to return, established defensive barriers, connected scout lines, and fortified twelve fortresses—whereupon Han and Qiang people followed one another home to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan also requested repair of the Chengping and Yongping fortresses, gradually recalled exiles, established defensive barriers, connected scout lines, and fortified twelve fortresses—whereupon Han and Qiang people followed one another home to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 久之，元昊歸陷將高延德，因與仲淹約和，仲淹為書戒喻之。

translations.literal: After some time Yuan Hao returned the captured general Gao Yande and accordingly negotiated peace with Zhongyan, who wrote a letter admonishing him.
translations.idiomatic: After some time Yuan Hao returned the captured general Gao Yande and accordingly negotiated peace with Zhongyan, who wrote a letter admonishing him.

sentences.zh: 會任福敗于好水川，元昊答書語不遜，仲淹對來使焚之。

translations.literal: When Ren Fu was defeated at Haoshui Creek, Yuan Hao's reply used insolent language; Zhongyan burned it before the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: When Ren Fu was defeated at Haoshui Creek, Yuan Hao's reply used insolent language; Zhongyan burned it before the envoy.

sentences.zh: 大臣以為不當輒通書，又不當輒焚之，宋庠請斬仲淹，帝不聽。

translations.literal: Senior ministers held that he should not have communicated by letter on his own authority, nor burned it on his own authority. Song Kui requested that Zhongyan be executed; the emperor would not hear of it.
translations.idiomatic: Senior ministers held that he should not have communicated by letter on his own authority, nor burned it on his own authority. Song Kui requested that Zhongyan be executed, but the emperor would not hear of it.

sentences.zh: 降本曹員外郎、知耀州，徙慶州，遷左司郎中，為環慶路經略安撫、緣邊招討使。

translations.literal: He was demoted in rank within his ministry to assistant director and made prefect of Yao Prefecture, transferred to Qing Prefecture, promoted to Director in the Left Secretariat, and appointed pacification and recruitment commissioner for the Huan-Qing circuit along the border.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted in rank within his ministry to assistant director and made prefect of Yao Prefecture, transferred to Qing Prefecture, promoted to Director in the Left Secretariat, and appointed pacification and recruitment commissioner for the Huan-Qing circuit along the border.

sentences.zh: 初，元昊反，陰誘屬羌為助，而環慶酋長六百余人，約為鄉道'事尋露。

translations.literal: Initially when Yuan Hao rebelled he had secretly lured subject Qiang tribes to assist him; more than six hundred chieftains of Huan and Qing had agreed to serve as local guides, but the matter was soon exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Initially when Yuan Hao rebelled he had secretly lured subject Qiang tribes to assist him; more than six hundred chieftains of Huan and Qing had agreed to serve as local guides, but the plot was soon exposed.

sentences.zh: 仲淹以其反復不常也，至部即奏行邊，以詔書犒賞諸羌，閱其人馬，為立條約：「若仇已和斷，輒私報之及傷人者，罰羊百、馬二，已殺者斬。

translations.literal: Because of their fickleness, as soon as Zhongyan arrived at his post he memorialized to tour the border and, by imperial edict, rewarded the various Qiang tribes with gifts; he inspected their men and horses and established regulations for them: 'If after a feud has been reconciled one privately reports it or injures another person, the fine is one hundred sheep and two horses; if someone has been killed, execution.
translations.idiomatic: Because of their fickleness, as soon as Zhongyan arrived at his post he memorialized to tour the border and, by imperial edict, rewarded the various Qiang tribes with gifts; he inspected their men and horses and established regulations: 'If after a feud has been reconciled one privately reports it or injures another person, the fine is one hundred sheep and two horses; if someone has been killed, execution.

sentences.zh: 負債爭訟，聽告官為理，輒質縛平人者，罰羊五十、馬一。

translations.literal: For debt disputes and lawsuits, one may report to officials for judgment; if one forcibly seizes and binds a free commoner, the fine is fifty sheep and one horse.
translations.idiomatic: For debt disputes and lawsuits, one may report to officials for judgment; if one forcibly seizes and binds a free commoner, the fine is fifty sheep and one horse.

sentences.zh: 賊馬入界，追集不赴隨本族，每戶罰羊二，質其首領。

translations.literal: When enemy horses enter the border, if one fails to muster and follow one's tribe to pursue, each household is fined two sheep, and the headman is taken as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: When enemy horses enter the border, if one fails to muster and follow one's tribe to pursue, each household is fined two sheep, and the headman is taken as hostage.

sentences.zh: 賊大入，老幼入保本砦，官為給食；

translations.literal: When the enemy invades in force, the old and young enter the nearest fortress and officials provide food;
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy invades in force, the old and young enter the nearest fortress and officials provide food;

sentences.zh: 即不入砦，本家罰羊二；

translations.literal: if one does not enter the fortress, that household is fined two sheep;
translations.idiomatic: if one does not enter the fortress, that household is fined two sheep;

sentences.zh: 全族不至，質其首領。」

translations.literal: if the entire clan fails to come, their headman is taken as hostage.'
translations.idiomatic: if the entire clan fails to come, their headman is taken as hostage.'

sentences.zh: 諸羌皆受命，自是始為漢用矣。

translations.literal: All the Qiang accepted these commands; from this time they began to serve the Han.
translations.idiomatic: All the Qiang accepted these commands; from this time they began to serve the Han.

sentences.zh: 改邠州觀察使，仲淹表言：「觀察使班待制下，臣守邊數年，羌人頗親愛臣，呼臣為'龍圖老子'。

translations.literal: He was made Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture. Zhongyan memorialized: 'The military commissioner's rank is below that of a Gentleman Consultant. I have defended the border for several years; the Qiang people have grown quite fond of me and call me "Old Man Longtu.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Military Commissioner of Bin Prefecture. Zhongyan memorialized: 'The military commissioner's rank is below that of a Gentleman Consultant. I have defended the border for several years; the Qiang people have grown quite fond of me and call me "Old Man Longtu.

sentences.zh: 今退而與王興、朱觀為伍，第恐為賊輕矣。」

translations.literal: Now to step back and be ranked with Wang Xing and Zhu Guan—I fear only that the enemy will hold me in contempt.'
translations.idiomatic: Now to step back and be ranked with Wang Xing and Zhu Guan—I fear the enemy will only hold me in contempt.'

sentences.zh: 辭不拜。

translations.literal: He declined and did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He declined and refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 慶之西北馬鋪砦，當後橋川口，在賊腹中。

translations.literal: Mapu Fort northwest of Qing Prefecture stood at the mouth of Houqiao Creek, deep within enemy territory.
translations.idiomatic: Mapu Fort northwest of Qing Prefecture stood at the mouth of Houqiao Creek, deep in enemy territory.

sentences.zh: 仲淹欲城之，度賊必爭，密遣子純祐與蕃將趙明先據其地，引兵隨之。

translations.literal: Zhongyan wished to fortify it and expected the enemy would contest it; he secretly sent his son Chunyou and the tribal general Zhao Ming to seize the ground first, then led troops after them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan wished to build a fort there and expected the enemy would contest it. He secretly sent his son Chunyou and the tribal general Zhao Ming to seize the ground first, then led troops after them.

sentences.zh: 諸將不知所向，行至柔遠，始號令之，版築皆具，旬日而城成，即大順城是也。

translations.literal: The generals did not know where they were going; only when they reached Rouyuan did he issue orders. Building materials were all ready, and in ten days the fort was completed—this was Dashun Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The generals did not know where they were headed; only when they reached Rouyuan did he issue orders. Building materials were all ready, and in ten days the fort was completed—this was Dashun Fort.

sentences.zh: 賊覺，以騎三萬來戰，佯北，仲淹戒勿追，已而果有伏。

translations.literal: The enemy discovered this and came with thirty thousand cavalry to fight; they feigned retreat, but Zhongyan warned against pursuit, and indeed there was an ambush.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy discovered this and came with thirty thousand cavalry to fight. They feigned retreat, but Zhongyan warned against pursuit—and indeed there was an ambush.

sentences.zh: 大順既城，而白豹、金湯皆不敢犯，環慶自此寇益少。

translations.literal: Once Dashun was fortified, Baibao and Jintang dared not violate it, and from this time raids in Huan and Qing grew fewer.
translations.idiomatic: Once Dashun was fortified, Baibao and Jintang dared not violate it, and from this time raids in Huan and Qing grew fewer.

sentences.zh: 明珠、滅臧勁兵數萬，仲淹聞涇原欲襲討之，上言曰：「二族道險，不可攻，前日高繼嵩已喪師。

translations.literal: Mingzhu and Miezang had strong forces numbering tens of thousands. Zhongyan heard that Jingyuan intended to launch a surprise attack on them and memorialized: 'The two tribes occupy dangerous routes and cannot be attacked; the other day Gao Jisong already lost his army.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhu and Miezang had strong forces numbering tens of thousands. Zhongyan heard that Jingyuan intended to launch a surprise attack on them and memorialized: 'The two tribes occupy dangerous routes and cannot be attacked; the other day Gao Jisong already lost his army.

sentences.zh: 平時且懷反側，今討之，必與賊表裏，南入原州，西擾鎮戎，東侵環州，邊患未艾也。

translations.literal: Even in normal times they harbor rebellious intent; if we attack them now, they will surely join the enemy inside and out, push south into Yuan Prefecture, harass Zhenrong in the west, and invade Huan Prefecture in the east—border troubles will not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Even in normal times they harbor rebellious intent. If we attack them now, they will surely join the enemy inside and out, push south into Yuan Prefecture, harass Zhenrong in the west, and invade Huan Prefecture in the east—border troubles will not cease.

sentences.zh: 若北取細腰、胡蘆眾泉為堡障，以斷賊路，則二族安，而環州、鎮戎徑道通徹，可無憂矣。」

translations.literal: If we take Xiyao and Hulu to the north and their many springs as defensive barriers to cut the enemy's routes, then the two tribes will be secure and the direct roads to Huan Prefecture and Zhenrong will be open—there will be nothing to worry about.'
translations.idiomatic: If we take Xiyao and Hulu to the north and their many springs as defensive barriers to cut the enemy's routes, the two tribes will be secure and the direct roads to Huan Prefecture and Zhenrong will be open—there will be nothing to worry about.'

sentences.zh: 其後，遂築細腰、胡蘆諸砦。

translations.literal: Thereafter they fortified Xiyao, Hulu, and the other fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter they fortified Xiyao, Hulu, and the other fortresses.

sentences.zh: 葛懷敏敗於定川，賊大掠至潘原，關中震恐，民多竄山谷間。

translations.literal: Ge Huaimin was defeated at Dingchuan; the enemy plundered as far as Panyuan. Guanzhong was shaken with fear, and many people fled into the mountains and valleys.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Huaimin was defeated at Dingchuan; the enemy plundered as far as Panyuan. Guanzhong was shaken with fear, and many people fled into the mountains and valleys.

sentences.zh: 仲淹率眾六千，由邠、涇援之，聞賊已出塞，乃還。

translations.literal: Zhongyan led six thousand men through Bin and Jing to relieve them; hearing that the enemy had already left the frontier, he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan led six thousand men through Bin and Jing to relieve them. Hearing that the enemy had already left the frontier, he returned.

sentences.zh: 始，定川事聞，帝按圖謂左右曰：「若仲淹出援，吾無憂矣。」

translations.literal: When news of Dingchuan first arrived, the emperor studied the map and said to those around him: 'If Zhongyan goes out to relieve them, I have no worries.'
translations.idiomatic: When news of Dingchuan first arrived, the emperor studied the map and said to those around him: 'If Zhongyan goes out to relieve them, I have no worries.'

sentences.zh: 奏至，帝大喜曰：「吾固知仲淹可用也。」

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, the emperor was greatly pleased and said: 'I always knew Zhongyan could be relied upon.'
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, the emperor was greatly pleased and said: 'I always knew Zhongyan could be relied upon.'

sentences.zh: 進樞密直學士、右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Academician Expositor in Direct Attendance at the Bureau of Military Affairs and Right Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Academician Expositor in Direct Attendance at the Bureau of Military Affairs and Right Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 仲淹以軍出無功，辭不敢受命，詔不聽。

translations.literal: Zhongyan, because his expedition had achieved no success, declined and dared not accept the appointment; an edict refused to hear of it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan, because his expedition had achieved no success, declined and dared not accept the appointment; an edict refused to hear of it.

sentences.zh: 時已命文彥博經略涇原，帝以涇原傷夷，欲對徙仲淹，遣王懷德喻之。

translations.literal: At that time Wen Yanbo had already been appointed to oversee Jingyuan; because Jingyuan had suffered heavy losses, the emperor wished to transfer Zhongyan in exchange and sent Wang Huaide to explain this to him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wen Yanbo had already been appointed to oversee Jingyuan. Because Jingyuan had suffered heavy losses, the emperor wished to transfer Zhongyan in exchange and sent Wang Huaide to explain this to him.

sentences.zh: 仲淹謝曰：「涇原地重，第恐臣不足當此路。

translations.literal: Zhongyan declined, saying: 'Jingyuan is a weighty post; I fear only that I am not equal to this route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan declined, saying: 'Jingyuan is a weighty post; I fear only that I am not equal to this route.

sentences.zh: 與韓琦同經略涇原，並駐涇州，琦兼秦鳳、臣兼環慶。

translations.literal: Together with Han Qi he should oversee Jingyuan, both stationed at Jing Prefecture; Qi would also cover Qin and Feng, and I would also cover Huan and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Han Qi he should oversee Jingyuan, both stationed at Jing Prefecture—Qi would also cover Qin and Feng, and I would also cover Huan and Qing.

sentences.zh: 涇原有警，臣與韓琦合秦鳳，環慶之兵，掎角而進；

translations.literal: If Jingyuan is alarmed, I and Han Qi will combine the forces of Qin-Feng and Huan-Qing and advance in pincer fashion;
translations.idiomatic: If Jingyuan is alarmed, Han Qi and I will combine the forces of Qin-Feng and Huan-Qing and advance in pincer fashion;

sentences.zh: 若秦鳳、環慶有警，亦可率涇原之師為援。

translations.literal: if Qin-Feng or Huan-Qing is alarmed, we can also lead the armies of Jingyuan as relief.
translations.idiomatic: if Qin-Feng or Huan-Qing is alarmed, we can also lead the armies of Jingyuan as relief.

sentences.zh: 臣當與琦練兵選將，漸復橫山，以斷賊臂，不數年間，可期平定矣。

translations.literal: I should train troops and select generals with Qi, gradually recover Hengshan, and cut off the enemy's arm—in a few years, pacification may be expected.
translations.idiomatic: I should train troops and select generals with Qi, gradually recover Hengshan, and cut off the enemy's arm—in a few years, pacification may be expected.

sentences.zh: 願詔龐籍兼領環慶，以成首尾之勢。

translations.literal: I ask that Pang Ji be ordered to also oversee Huan and Qing, so as to form a head-and-tail disposition.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Pang Ji be ordered to also oversee Huan and Qing, so as to form a coordinated front and rear.

sentences.zh: 秦州委文彥博，慶州用滕宗諒總之。

translations.literal: Qin Prefecture should be entrusted to Wen Yanbo, and Qing Prefecture placed under Teng Zongliang's overall command.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Prefecture should be entrusted to Wen Yanbo, and Qing Prefecture placed under Teng Zongliang's overall command.

sentences.zh: 孫沔亦可辦集。

translations.literal: Sun Mian can also handle the gathering of forces.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Mian can also handle the gathering of forces.

sentences.zh: 渭州，一武臣足矣。」

translations.literal: For Wei Prefecture, one military official is sufficient.'
translations.idiomatic: For Wei Prefecture, one military official is sufficient.'

sentences.zh: 帝採用其言，復置陝西路安撫、經略、招討使，以仲淹、韓琦、龐籍分領之。

translations.literal: The emperor adopted his proposal, restored the posts of pacification, military oversight, and recruitment commissioner for the Shaanxi circuit, and had Zhongyan, Han Qi, and Pang Ji divide command among them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor adopted his proposal, restored the posts of pacification, military oversight, and recruitment commissioner for the Shaanxi circuit, and had Zhongyan, Han Qi, and Pang Ji divide command among them.

sentences.zh: 仲淹與琦開府涇州，而徙彥博帥秦，宗諒帥慶，張亢帥渭。

translations.literal: Zhongyan and Qi opened their headquarters at Jing Prefecture, while Yanbo was transferred to command Qin, Zongliang to command Qing, and Zhang Kang to command Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan and Qi opened their headquarters at Jing Prefecture, while Yanbo was transferred to command Qin, Zongliang to command Qing, and Zhang Kang to command Wei.

sentences.zh: 仲淹為將，號令明白，愛撫士卒，諸羌來者，推心接之不疑，故賊亦不敢輒犯其境。

translations.literal: As a general Zhongyan's orders were clear, he cherished and comforted his soldiers, and toward Qiang who came to him he received them with open sincerity and without suspicion; thus the enemy also did not dare lightly violate his territory.
translations.idiomatic: As a general Zhongyan's orders were clear. He cherished and comforted his soldiers, and toward Qiang who came to him he received them with open sincerity and without suspicion; thus the enemy also did not dare lightly violate his territory.

sentences.zh: 元昊請和，召拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: When Yuan Hao requested peace, Zhongyan was summoned and appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Hao requested peace, Zhongyan was summoned and appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 王舉正懦默不任事，諫官歐陽修等言仲淹有相材，請罷舉正用仲淹，遂改參知政事。

translations.literal: Wang Juzheng was timid and silent and did not attend to affairs; remonstrating officials such as Ouyang Xiu said Zhongyan had the talent of a chief councilor and requested that Juzheng be dismissed and Zhongyan used; he was then changed to Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Juzheng was timid and silent and did not attend to affairs. Remonstrating officials such as Ouyang Xiu said Zhongyan had the talent of a chief councilor and requested that Juzheng be dismissed and Zhongyan used; he was then appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 仲淹曰：「執政可由諫官而得乎？」

translations.literal: Zhongyan said: 'Can one obtain governing power through remonstrating officials?'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan said: 'Can one obtain governing power through remonstrating officials?'

sentences.zh: 固辭不拜，願與韓琦出行邊。

translations.literal: He firmly declined and would not accept, wishing instead to go to the border with Han Qi.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly declined and would not accept, wishing instead to go to the border with Han Qi.

sentences.zh: 命為陝西宣撫使，未行，復除參知政事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Shaanxi pacification commissioner; before he departed he was again appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Shaanxi pacification commissioner; before he departed he was again appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 會王倫寇淮南，州縣官有不能守者，朝廷欲按誅之。

translations.literal: When Wang Lun raided Huainan, some prefectural and county officials could not hold their posts; the court wished to investigate and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Lun raided Huainan, some prefectural and county officials could not hold their posts; the court wished to investigate and execute them.

sentences.zh: 仲淹曰：「平時諱言武備，寇至而專責守臣死事，可乎？」

translations.literal: Zhongyan said: 'In normal times we avoid speaking of military preparedness, yet when bandits arrive we hold defending officials solely responsible to die at their posts—is this acceptable?'
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan said: 'In normal times we avoid speaking of military preparedness, yet when bandits arrive we hold defending officials solely responsible to die at their posts—is this acceptable?'

sentences.zh: 守令皆得不誅。

translations.literal: The prefects and magistrates were all spared execution.
translations.idiomatic: The prefects and magistrates were all spared execution.

sentences.zh: 帝方銳意太平，數問當世事，仲淹語人曰：「上用我至矣，事有先後，久安之弊，非朝夕可革也。」

translations.literal: The emperor was then keenly intent on great peace and repeatedly asked about current affairs. Zhongyan told others: 'The emperor's use of me has reached its height; affairs have an order of priority—the abuses of long peace cannot be reformed overnight.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then keenly intent on great peace and repeatedly asked about current affairs. Zhongyan told others: 'The emperor's use of me has reached its height. Affairs have an order of priority—the abuses of long peace cannot be reformed overnight.'

sentences.zh: 帝再賜手詔，又為之開天章閣，召二府條對，仲淹皇恐，退而上十事：

translations.literal: The emperor twice bestowed handwritten edicts, also opened the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations for him, and summoned the two councils to respond item by item. Zhongyan was awed and fearful; he withdrew and submitted ten items:
translations.idiomatic: The emperor twice bestowed handwritten edicts, also opened the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations for him, and summoned the two councils to respond item by item. Zhongyan was awed and fearful; he withdrew and submitted ten items:

sentences.zh: 一曰明黜陟。

translations.literal: First: make promotions and demotions clear.
translations.idiomatic: First: make promotions and demotions clear.

sentences.zh: 二府非有大功大善者不遷，內外須在職滿三年，在京百司非選舉而授，須通滿五年，乃得磨勘，庶幾考績之法矣。

translations.literal: Those in the two councils should not be transferred unless they have great merit or great virtue; inside and outside the capital one must serve a full three years in office, and those in the capital bureaus who were appointed without examination must serve a full five years before merit review—thus the method of evaluating performance may be realized.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the two councils should not be transferred unless they have great merit or great virtue. Inside and outside the capital one must serve a full three years in office, and those in the capital bureaus who were appointed without examination must serve a full five years before merit review—thus the method of evaluating performance may be realized.

sentences.zh: 二曰抑僥倖。

translations.literal: Second: restrain undeserved favor.
translations.idiomatic: Second: restrain undeserved favor.

sentences.zh: 罷少卿、監以上乾元節恩澤；

translations.literal: Abolish Qianyuan Festival favors for assistant directors and supervisors and above;
translations.idiomatic: Abolish Qianyuan Festival favors for assistant directors and supervisors and above;

sentences.zh: 正郎以下若監司、邊任，須在職滿二年，始得蔭子；

translations.literal: for regular directors and below, as well as supervisory commissioners and border posts, one must serve a full two years in office before one's sons may receive inherited privilege;
translations.idiomatic: for regular directors and below, as well as supervisory commissioners and border posts, one must serve a full two years in office before one's sons may receive inherited privilege;

sentences.zh: 大臣不得薦子弟任館閣職，蔭子之法無冗濫矣。

translations.literal: great ministers may not recommend their sons and younger brothers for archive posts—the law of inherited privilege will no longer be redundant and excessive.
translations.idiomatic: great ministers may not recommend their sons and younger brothers for archive posts—the law of inherited privilege will no longer be redundant and excessive.

sentences.zh: 三曰精貢舉。

translations.literal: Third: refine the examination and recommendation system.
translations.idiomatic: Third: refine the examination and recommendation system.

sentences.zh: 進士、諸科請罷糊名法，參考履行無闕者，以名聞。

translations.literal: For jinshi and other examination categories, request abolition of the sealed-name method; those whose conduct upon investigation is without fault should be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: For jinshi and other examination categories, request abolition of the sealed-name method. Those whose conduct upon investigation is without fault should be reported by name.

sentences.zh: 進士先策論，後詩賦，諸科取兼通經義者。

translations.literal: For jinshi, policy essays first and then poetry and rhapsodies; for other categories select those who broadly master classical meaning.
translations.idiomatic: For jinshi, policy essays first and then poetry and rhapsodies; for other categories select those who broadly master classical meaning.

sentences.zh: 賜第以上，皆取詔裁。

translations.literal: Those granted palace rank and above should all be subject to edictal decision.
translations.idiomatic: Those granted palace rank and above should all be subject to edictal decision.

sentences.zh: 餘優等免選注官，次第人守本科選。

translations.literal: The remaining top grades are exempt from selection and appointment; those in order remain within their original category's selection.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining top grades are exempt from selection and appointment; those in order remain within their original category's selection.

sentences.zh: 進士之法，可以循名而責實矣。

translations.literal: The jinshi system can then match names to actual merit.
translations.idiomatic: The jinshi system can then match names to actual merit.

sentences.zh: 四曰擇長官。

translations.literal: Fourth: select chief local officials.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: select chief local officials.

sentences.zh: 委中書、樞密院先選轉運使、提點刑獄、大藩知州；

translations.literal: Entrust the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs first to select transport commissioners, judicial intendant commissioners, and prefects of major prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Entrust the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs first to select transport commissioners, judicial intendant commissioners, and prefects of major prefectures;

sentences.zh: 次委兩制、三司、御史台、開封府官、諸路監司舉知州、通判；

translations.literal: next entrust drafters, the three fiscal commissions, the Censorate, Kaifeng officials, and route supervisory commissioners to recommend prefects and vice-prefects;
translations.idiomatic: next entrust drafters, the three fiscal commissions, the Censorate, Kaifeng officials, and route supervisory commissioners to recommend prefects and vice-prefects;

sentences.zh: 知州通判舉知縣、令。

translations.literal: prefects and vice-prefects recommend magistrates and district chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: prefects and vice-prefects recommend magistrates and district chiefs.

sentences.zh: 限其人數，以舉主多者從中書選除。

translations.literal: Limit the number of persons; where recommending hosts are numerous, the Secretariat selects and appoints from among them.
translations.idiomatic: Limit the number of nominees; where recommending hosts are numerous, the Secretariat selects and appoints from among them.

sentences.zh: 刺史、縣令，可以得人矣。

translations.literal: Prefects and magistrates can then obtain the right men.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates can then obtain the right men.

sentences.zh: 五曰均公田。

translations.literal: Fifth: equalize public fields.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: equalize public fields.

sentences.zh: 外官廩給不均，何以求其為善耶？

translations.literal: External officials' salary provisions are unequal—how can one expect them to do good?
translations.idiomatic: External officials' salary provisions are unequal—how can one expect them to do good?

sentences.zh: 請均其入，第給之，使有以自養，然後可以責廉節，而不法者可誅廢矣。

translations.literal: Request that their income be equalized and simply provided, so they have means to support themselves; only then can integrity be required, and those who violate the law may be punished and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Request that their income be equalized and simply provided, so they have means to support themselves. Only then can integrity be required, and those who violate the law may be punished and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六曰厚農桑。

translations.literal: Sixth: strengthen agriculture and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: strengthen agriculture and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 每歲預下諸路，風吏民言農田利害，堤堰渠塘，州縣選官治之。

translations.literal: Each year send down instructions to all routes in advance, encouraging officials and people to report on the benefits and harms of farmland, dikes, weirs, canals, and ponds; prefectures and counties select officials to manage them.
translations.idiomatic: Each year send down instructions to all routes in advance, encouraging officials and people to report on the benefits and harms of farmland, dikes, weirs, canals, and ponds. Prefectures and counties select officials to manage them.

sentences.zh: 定勸課之法以興農利，減漕運。

translations.literal: Establish methods of encouraging production to promote agricultural profit and reduce grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Establish methods of encouraging production to promote agricultural profit and reduce grain transport.

sentences.zh: 江南之圩田，浙西之河塘，隳廢者可興矣。

translations.literal: The polder fields of Jiangnan and the river ponds of western Zhe can be revived where they have fallen into ruin.
translations.idiomatic: The polder fields of Jiangnan and the river ponds of western Zhe can be revived where they have fallen into ruin.

sentences.zh: 七曰修武備。

translations.literal: Seventh: repair military preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: repair military preparedness.

sentences.zh: 約府兵法，募畿輔強壯為衛士，以助正兵。

translations.literal: Following the capital guard military method, recruit strong men from the capital region as guard soldiers to assist the regular army.
translations.idiomatic: Following the capital guard military method, recruit strong men from the capital region as guard soldiers to assist the regular army.

sentences.zh: 三時務農，一時教戰，省給贍之費。

translations.literal: Three seasons devoted to farming, one season to military training—saving the cost of provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Three seasons devoted to farming, one season to military training—saving the cost of provisions.

sentences.zh: 畿輔有成法，則諸道皆可舉行矣。

translations.literal: If the capital region has an established method, then all circuits can implement it.
translations.idiomatic: If the capital region has an established method, then all circuits can implement it.

sentences.zh: 八曰推恩信。

translations.literal: Eighth: extend favor and trust.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: extend favor and trust.

sentences.zh: 赦令有所施行，主司稽違者，重置於法；

translations.literal: When amnesty edicts are to be implemented, responsible offices that delay or violate them should be heavily punished according to law;
translations.idiomatic: When amnesty edicts are to be implemented, responsible offices that delay or violate them should be heavily punished according to law;

sentences.zh: 別遣使按視其所當行者，所在無廢格上恩者矣。

translations.literal: separately dispatch envoys to inspect what should be carried out, so that nowhere will imperial favor be nullified.
translations.idiomatic: separately dispatch envoys to inspect what should be carried out, so that nowhere will imperial favor be nullified.

sentences.zh: 九曰重命令。

translations.literal: Ninth: give weight to commands.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: give weight to commands.

sentences.zh: 法度所以示信也，行之未幾，旋即厘改。

translations.literal: Laws and standards exist to show trustworthiness, yet before they have been in force long they are immediately revised.
translations.idiomatic: Laws and standards exist to show trustworthiness, yet before they have been in force long they are immediately revised.

sentences.zh: 請政事之臣參議可以久行者，刪去煩冗，裁為制敕行下，命令不至於數變更矣。

translations.literal: Request that governing ministers jointly discuss what can be long maintained, delete the redundant, trim them into regulations and edicts for issuance, so commands will not be changed repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Request that governing ministers jointly discuss what can be long maintained, delete the redundant, trim them into regulations and edicts for issuance, so commands will not be changed repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 十曰減徭役。

translations.literal: Tenth: reduce corvée and labor service.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: reduce corvée and labor service.

sentences.zh: 戶口耗少而供億滋多，省縣邑戶少者為鎮，並使、州兩院為一，職官白直，給以州兵，其不應受役者悉歸之農，民無重困之憂矣。

translations.literal: Households have dwindled while supplies demanded have increased. Reduce counties and districts with few households to market towns, merge the two courts of circuit and prefecture into one, assign official runners and guards state troops, and return all who should not bear corvée to farming—the people will be free from the worry of heavy oppression.
translations.idiomatic: Households have dwindled while supplies demanded have increased. Reduce counties and districts with few households to market towns, merge the two courts of circuit and prefecture into one, assign official runners and guards state troops, and return all who should not bear corvée to farming—the people will be free from the worry of heavy oppression.

sentences.zh: 天子方信向仲淹，悉採用之，宜著令者，皆以詔書畫一頒下；

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven was then placing full trust in Zhongyan and adopted all his proposals; where regulations should be established, unified edicts were issued;
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven was then placing full trust in Zhongyan and adopted all his proposals. Where regulations should be established, unified edicts were issued;

sentences.zh: 獨府兵法，眾以為不可而止。

translations.literal: only the capital guard military method was halted because the multitude deemed it unworkable.
translations.idiomatic: only the capital guard military method was halted because the multitude deemed it unworkable.

sentences.zh: 又建言：「周制，三公分兼六官之職，漢以三公分部六卿，唐以宰相分判六曹。

translations.literal: He also proposed: 'Under the Zhou system the Three Dukes concurrently held the duties of the Six Offices; Han had the Three Dukes divide supervision among the Six Ministers; Tang had chief councilors divide judgment among the Six Bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed: 'Under the Zhou system the Three Dukes concurrently held the duties of the Six Offices; Han had the Three Dukes divide supervision among the Six Ministers; Tang had chief councilors divide judgment among the Six Bureaus.

sentences.zh: 今中書，古天官塚宰也，樞密院，古夏官司馬也。

translations.literal: Today the Secretariat is the ancient Heavenly Office Grand Steward; the Bureau of Military Affairs is the ancient Summer Office Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Today the Secretariat is the ancient Heavenly Office Grand Steward; the Bureau of Military Affairs is the ancient Summer Office Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 四官散於群有司，無三公兼領之重。

translations.literal: The four offices are scattered among the various departments, without the weight of the Three Dukes' concurrent leadership.
translations.idiomatic: The four offices are scattered among the various departments, without the weight of the Three Dukes' concurrent leadership.

sentences.zh: 而二府惟進擢差除，循資級，議賞罰，檢用條例而已。

translations.literal: Yet the two councils only promote, appoint, follow seniority ranks, discuss rewards and punishments, and check against regulations—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the two councils only promote, appoint, follow seniority ranks, discuss rewards and punishments, and check against regulations—that is all.

sentences.zh: 上非三公論道之任，下無六卿佐王之職，非治法也。

translations.literal: Above there is not the Three Dukes' duty of discussing the Way; below there are not the Six Ministers' offices of assisting the ruler—this is not proper governance.
translations.idiomatic: Above there is not the Three Dukes' duty of discussing the Way; below there are not the Six Ministers' offices of assisting the ruler—this is not proper governance.

sentences.zh: 臣請仿前代，以三司、司農、審官、流內銓、三班院、國子監、太常、刑部、審刑、大理、群牧、殿前馬步軍司，各委輔臣兼判其事。

translations.literal: Your subject requests following previous dynasties: the Three Commissions, Agriculture Commission, Office of Review, Within-the-Flow Selection Office, Three-Rank Court, Directorate of Education, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Ministry of Punishments, Office of Judicial Review, Court of Judicial Review, Pasturage Commission, and Palace Front Horse and Foot Army Command—each should be entrusted to assisting ministers to concurrently judge their affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject requests following previous dynasties: the Three Commissions, Agriculture Commission, Office of Review, Within-the-Flow Selection Office, Three-Rank Court, Directorate of Education, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Ministry of Punishments, Office of Judicial Review, Court of Judicial Review, Pasturage Commission, and Palace Front Horse and Foot Army Command—each should be entrusted to assisting ministers to concurrently judge their affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡官吏黜陟、刑法重輕、事有利害者，並從輔臣予奪：其體大者，二府僉議奏裁。

translations.literal: All matters of officials' promotion and demotion, the severity of criminal law, and affairs of benefit or harm should be decided by assisting ministers; for those of larger scope, the two councils jointly discuss and memorialize for decision.
translations.idiomatic: All matters of officials' promotion and demotion, the severity of criminal law, and affairs of benefit or harm should be decided by assisting ministers. For those of larger scope, the two councils jointly discuss and memorialize for decision.

sentences.zh: 臣請自領兵賦之職，如其無補，請先黜降。」

translations.literal: Your subject requests to take charge of military and fiscal duties himself; if they prove unhelpful, please demote me first.'
translations.idiomatic: Your subject requests to take charge of military and fiscal duties himself. If they prove unhelpful, please demote me first.'

sentences.zh: 章得象等皆曰不可。

translations.literal: Zhang Dexiang and others all said it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dexiang and others all said it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 久之，乃命參知政事賈昌朝領農田，仲淹領刑法，然卒不果行。

translations.literal: After some time they ordered Vice Grand Councilor Jia Changchao to oversee agriculture and Zhongyan to oversee criminal law, but in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: After some time they ordered Vice Grand Councilor Jia Changchao to oversee agriculture and Zhongyan to oversee criminal law, but in the end it was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 初，仲淹以忤呂夷簡，放逐者數年，士大夫持二人曲直，交指為朋黨。

translations.literal: Initially, because Zhongyan had offended Lü Yijian, he was banished for several years; the gentry took sides on the rights and wrongs of the two men and mutually denounced each other as clique members.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, because Zhongyan had offended Lü Yijian, he was banished for several years. The gentry took sides on the rights and wrongs of the two men and mutually denounced each other as clique members.

sentences.zh: 及陝西用兵，天子以仲淹士望所屬，拔用之。

translations.literal: When military operations began in Shaanxi, the Son of Heaven, because the gentry's esteem rested on Zhongyan, promoted and used him.
translations.idiomatic: When military operations began in Shaanxi, the Son of Heaven, because the gentry's esteem rested on Zhongyan, promoted and used him.

sentences.zh: 及夷簡罷，召還，倚以為治，中外想望其功業。

translations.literal: When Yijian was dismissed, Zhongyan was recalled and relied upon for governance; inside and outside the court all looked to his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: When Yijian was dismissed, Zhongyan was recalled and relied upon for governance. Inside and outside the court all looked to his achievements.

sentences.zh: 而仲淹以天下為己任，裁削幸濫，考覈官吏，日夜謀慮興致太平。

translations.literal: Yet Zhongyan took the realm as his own responsibility, cut back favoritism and excess, examined officials, and day and night plotted to bring about great peace.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhongyan took the realm as his own responsibility, cut back favoritism and excess, examined officials, and day and night plotted to bring about great peace.

sentences.zh: 然更張無漸，規摹闊大，論者以為不可行。

translations.literal: Yet his reforms lacked gradualness, his plans were broad and large, and critics held them unworkable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his reforms lacked gradualness, his plans were broad and large, and critics held them unworkable.

sentences.zh: 及按察使出，多所舉劾，人心不悅。

translations.literal: When investigative commissioners went out and impeached many, hearts were displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When investigative commissioners went out and impeached many, hearts were displeased.

sentences.zh: 自任子之恩薄，磨勘之法密，僥倖者不便，於是謗毀稍行，而朋黨之論浸聞上矣。

translations.literal: Since favors for sons by inherited privilege grew thin and merit review grew strict, those who relied on luck found it inconvenient; thus slander gradually spread, and talk of cliques gradually reached the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Since favors for sons by inherited privilege grew thin and merit review grew strict, those who relied on luck found it inconvenient. Thus slander gradually spread, and talk of cliques gradually reached the emperor.

sentences.zh: 會邊陲有警，因與樞密副使富弼請行邊。

translations.literal: When there was alarm on the frontier, he therefore joined Vice Commissioner Fu Bi in requesting to go to the border.
translations.idiomatic: When there was alarm on the frontier, he joined Vice Commissioner Fu Bi in requesting to go to the border.

sentences.zh: 於是，以仲淹為河東、陝西宣撫使，賜黃金百兩，悉分遺邊將。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhongyan was made pacification commissioner for Hedong and Shaanxi; he was granted one hundred taels of gold and distributed them all to border generals.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Zhongyan was made pacification commissioner for Hedong and Shaanxi. He was granted one hundred taels of gold and distributed them all to border generals.

sentences.zh: 麟州新罹大寇，言者多請棄之，仲淹為修故砦，招還流亡三千餘戶，蠲其稅，罷榷酤予民。

translations.literal: Lin Prefecture had recently suffered a major raid; many who spoke on policy requested abandoning it. Zhongyan repaired the old fortresses, recalled more than three thousand refugee households, remitted their taxes, and abolished the government liquor monopoly in favor of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Prefecture had recently suffered a major raid; many who spoke on policy requested abandoning it. Zhongyan repaired the old fortresses, recalled more than three thousand refugee households, remitted their taxes, and abolished the government liquor monopoly in favor of the people.

sentences.zh: 又奏免府州商稅，河外遂安。

translations.literal: He also memorialized remission of commercial tax in Fu Prefecture, and the region west of the Yellow River was thus pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized remission of commercial tax in Fu Prefecture, and the region west of the Yellow River was thus pacified.

sentences.zh: 比去。

translations.literal: When he was about to depart.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly before he left the capital.

sentences.zh: 攻者益急，仲淹亦自請罷政事，乃以為資政殿學士、陝西四路宣撫使、知邠州。

translations.literal: The attackers grew ever more urgent, and Zhongyan also requested on his own to be removed from government affairs; thereupon he was appointed Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Governance, Pacification Commissioner of the Four Circuits of Shaanxi, and Prefect of Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The attacks against him intensified, and Zhongyan himself asked to be relieved of his ministerial duties. He was then made Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Governance, Pacification Commissioner for the four Shaanxi circuits, and Prefect of Bin.

sentences.zh: 其在中書所施為，亦稍稍沮罷。

translations.literal: What he had implemented in the Secretariat was also gradually obstructed and abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: The policies he had put in place at the Secretariat were also gradually blocked and rolled back.

sentences.zh: 以疾請鄧州，進給事中。

translations.literal: Because of illness he requested Deng Prefecture, and was promoted to Drafting Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Illness led him to request a post at Deng Prefecture, and he was promoted to Drafting Attendant.

sentences.zh: 徙荊南，鄧人遮使者請留，仲淹亦願留鄧，許之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Jingnan; the people of Deng blocked the envoy to request that he remain, and Zhongyan also wished to stay in Deng, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When he was reassigned to Jingnan, the people of Deng intercepted the imperial messenger and begged that he be kept. Zhongyan too wished to remain at Deng, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 尋徙杭州，再遷戶部侍郎，徙青州。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Hang Prefecture, again promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue, and transferred to Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon moved to Hang Prefecture, promoted again to Vice Minister of Revenue, and then transferred to Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會病甚，請潁州，未至而卒，年六十四。

translations.literal: As his illness became severe, he requested Ying Prefecture; before he arrived he died, at the age of sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: When his illness grew grave, he asked to go to Ying Prefecture, but died before he could reach it, at the age of sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 贈兵部尚書，諡文正。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Minister of War, with the posthumous title Wenzheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of War and given the posthumous name Wenzheng, "Upright in Culture."

sentences.zh: 初，仲淹病，帝常遣使賜藥存問，既卒，嗟悼久之。

translations.literal: Initially, when Zhongyan was ill, the emperor often sent envoys to bestow medicine and inquire after him; after his death, the emperor sighed and mourned for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: While Zhongyan was ill, the emperor had often sent messengers with medicine to inquire after his health. After his death, the emperor sighed in grief for a long while.

sentences.zh: 又遣使就問其家，既葬，帝親書其碑曰「褒賢之碑。」

translations.literal: The emperor also sent an envoy to inquire of his household; after the burial, the emperor personally wrote his stele, saying "Stele in Commendation of the Worthy."
translations.idiomatic: He also dispatched an envoy to visit the family. Once the funeral was over, the emperor personally inscribed the stele with the title "Stele in Commendation of the Worthy."

sentences.zh: 仲淹內剛外和，性至孝，以母在時方貧，其後雖貴，非賓客不重肉。
