translations.idiomatic: If one can blame oneself with the mind one uses to blame others, and forgive others with the mind one uses to forgive oneself, one need not fear failing to reach the station of sages."

sentences.zh: 又戒曰：「《六經》，聖人之事也。

translations.literal: He also warned: "The Six Classics are the business of the sages.
translations.idiomatic: He also warned, "The Six Classics are the business of the sages.

sentences.zh: 知一字則行一字。

translations.literal: Understand one word and practice one word.
translations.idiomatic: Understand one word and practice one word.

sentences.zh: 要須'造次顛沛必於是'，則所謂'有為者亦若是'爾。

translations.literal: One must 'in haste and in distress be devoted to this'—then what is called 'he who would act must be like this' applies.
translations.idiomatic: One must "in haste and in distress be devoted to this"—then what is called "he who would act must be like this" applies.

sentences.zh: 豈不在人邪？」

translations.literal: Is it not in the person?"
translations.idiomatic: Is it not all in the person?"

sentences.zh: 弟純粹在關陝，純仁慮其于西夏有立功意。

translations.literal: His younger brother Chun Cui was in Guan and Shan; Chunren feared he intended to win merit against Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Chun Cui was in Guan and Shan; Chunren feared he intended to win merit against Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 與之書曰：「大輅與柴車爭逐，明珠與瓦礫相觸，君子與小人鬥力，中國與外邦校勝負，非唯不可勝，兼亦不足勝，不唯不足勝，雖勝亦非也。」

translations.literal: He wrote him: "A great carriage racing a firewood cart, a bright pearl striking common tile—a gentleman wrestling a petty man, the Middle Kingdom contending with a foreign state for victory: not only can one not win, one also ought not win; not only ought one not win—even winning would not be right."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote him, "A great carriage racing a firewood cart, a bright pearl striking common tile—a gentleman wrestling a petty man, the Middle Kingdom contending with a foreign state for victory: not only can one not win, one also ought not win; not only ought one not win—even winning would not be right."

sentences.zh: 親族有請教者，純仁曰：「惟儉可以助廉，惟恕可以成德。」

translations.literal: When kinsmen asked his teaching, Chunren said: "Only frugality can assist integrity; only forbearance can complete virtue."
translations.idiomatic: When kinsmen asked his teaching, Chunren said, "Only frugality can assist integrity; only forbearance can complete virtue."

sentences.zh: 其人書於坐隅。

translations.literal: The man wrote this at the corner of his seat.
translations.idiomatic: The man wrote this at the corner of his seat.

sentences.zh: 有文集五十卷，行於世。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in fifty juan, circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He had collected works in fifty juan, circulated in the world.

sentences.zh: 子正平、正思。

translations.literal: His sons were Zhengping and Zhengsi.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Zhengping and Zhengsi.

sentences.zh: 子 正平

translations.literal: Son Zhengping
translations.idiomatic: Son: Zhengping

sentences.zh: 正平字子夷，學行甚高，雖庸言必援《孝經》、《論語》。

translations.literal: Zhengping, courtesy name Ziyi, was very high in learning and conduct; even in ordinary speech he always cited the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengping, styled Ziyi, was very high in learning and conduct; even in ordinary speech he always cited the Classic of Filial Piety and the Analects.

sentences.zh: 父純仁卒，詔特增遺澤，官其子孫，正平推與幼弟。

translations.literal: When his father Chunren died, an edict specially added extra favor and office for his sons and grandsons; Zhengping yielded the benefit to his youngest brother.
translations.idiomatic: When his father Chunren died, an edict specially added extra favor and office for his sons and grandsons; Zhengping yielded the benefit to his youngest brother.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，為開封尉，有向氏於其墳造慈雲寺。

translations.literal: During the Shaosheng era he was a captain of the Kaifeng guard; the Xiang clan built the Ciyun Temple at their grave.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaosheng era he was a captain of the Kaifeng guard; the Xiang clan built the Ciyun Temple at their grave.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書蔡京以向氏後戚，規欲自結，奏拓四鄰田廬。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Cai Jing, because the Xiang were maternal kin of the empress, wished to win them over and memorialized to expand the neighboring fields and buildings.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Cai Jing, because the Xiang were maternal kin of the empress, wished to win them over and memorialized to expand the neighboring fields and buildings.

sentences.zh: 民有訴者，正平按視，以為所拓皆民業，不可奪；

translations.literal: When commoners petitioned, Zhengping inspected on site and held that all land taken was people's property and could not be seized;
translations.idiomatic: When commoners petitioned, Zhengping inspected on site and held that all land taken was people's property and could not be seized;

sentences.zh: 民又撾鼓上訴，京坐罰金二十斤，用是蓄恨正平。

translations.literal: the people again beat the drum to appeal upward; Jing was fined twenty jin of gold and on this account nursed hatred for Zhengping.
translations.idiomatic: the people again beat the drum to appeal upward; Jing was fined twenty jin of gold and on this account nursed hatred for Zhengping.

sentences.zh: 及當國，乃言正平矯撰父遺表。

translations.literal: When he came to power he said Zhengping had forged his father's final memorial.
translations.idiomatic: When he came to power he said Zhengping had forged his father's final memorial.

sentences.zh: 又謂李之儀所述《純仁行狀》，妄載中使蔡克明傳二聖虛佇之意，遂以正平逮之儀、克明同詣御史府。

translations.literal: He also said that Li Zhiyi's account of Chunren's conduct biography had falsely recorded the eunuch Cai Keming's transmission of the two emperors' empty waiting—thereupon Zhengping was taken together with Zhiyi and Keming to the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He also said that Li Zhiyi's account of Chunren's conduct biography had falsely recorded the eunuch Cai Keming's transmission of the two emperors' empty waiting—thereupon Zhengping was taken together with Zhiyi and Keming to the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 正平將行，其弟正思曰：「議《行狀》時，兄方營窀穸之事，參預筆削者，正思也，兄何為哉？」

translations.literal: As Zhengping was about to go, his younger brother Zhengsi said: "When the conduct biography was debated, you were arranging burial affairs; the one who took part in the writing was I—what are you doing?"
translations.idiomatic: As Zhengping was about to go, his younger brother Zhengsi said, "When the conduct biography was debated, you were arranging burial affairs; the one who took part in the writing was I—what are you doing?"

sentences.zh: 正平曰：「時相意屬我，且我居長，我不往，兄弟俱將不免，不若身任之。」

translations.literal: Zhengping said: "The chief minister's intent falls on me, and I am the eldest—I will not go and then both brothers will not escape; better that I bear it alone."
translations.idiomatic: Zhengping said, "The chief minister's intent falls on me, and I am the eldest—I will not go and then both brothers will not escape; better that I bear it alone."

sentences.zh: 遂就獄，捶楚甚苦，皆欲誣服。

translations.literal: He then entered prison; the beating and torture were very severe—all wished to force false confession.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered prison; the beating and torture were very severe—all wished to force false confession.

sentences.zh: 獨克明曰：「舊制，凡傳聖語，受本於御前，請寶印出，注籍於內東門。」

translations.literal: Only Keming said: "By old regulation, whenever imperial words are transmitted, one receives the text at the imperial presence, requests the seal to be affixed and brought out, and registers it at the inner east gate."
translations.idiomatic: Only Keming said, "By old regulation, whenever imperial words are transmitted, one receives the text at the imperial presence, requests the seal to be affixed and brought out, and registers it at the inner east gate."

sentences.zh: 使從其家得永州傳宣聖語本有御寶，又驗內東門籍皆同。

translations.literal: Messengers obtained from his home the Yong Prefecture transmission of imperial words with the imperial seal, and verification of the inner east gate register all matched.
translations.idiomatic: Messengers obtained from his home the Yong Prefecture transmission of imperial words with the imperial seal, and verification of the inner east gate register all matched.

sentences.zh: 其遺表八事，諸子以朝廷大事，防後患，不敢上之，繳申潁昌府印寄軍資庫。

translations.literal: As for the eight items in the final memorial, the sons, considering them great affairs of state and fearing later trouble, did not dare submit them; they turned them in under seal to Yingchang Prefecture and deposited them in the military supplies store.
translations.idiomatic: As for the eight items in the final memorial, the sons, considering them great affairs of state and fearing later trouble, did not dare submit them; they turned them in under seal to Yingchang Prefecture and deposited them in the military supplies store.

sentences.zh: 自潁昌取至，亦實。

translations.literal: When they were fetched from Yingchang, these too proved genuine.
translations.idiomatic: When they were fetched from Yingchang, these too proved genuine.

sentences.zh: 獄遂解。

translations.literal: The case was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The case was then dismissed.

sentences.zh: 正平羈管象州，之儀羈管太平州。

translations.literal: Zhengping was placed under restraint at Xiang Prefecture; Zhiyi was placed under restraint at Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengping was placed under restraint at Xiang Prefecture; Zhiyi was placed under restraint at Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正平家屬死者十余人。

translations.literal: More than ten of Zhengping's family died.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten members of Zhengping's family died.

sentences.zh: 會赦，得歸潁昌。

translations.literal: When an amnesty was proclaimed he was able to return to Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: When an amnesty was proclaimed he was able to return to Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 唐君益為守，表其所居為忠直坊，取所賜「世濟忠直」碑額也。

translations.literal: Tang Junyi was prefect and had his residence marked as the Loyal and Upright Ward, taking the bestowed stele inscription "Loyalty and Uprightness Handed Down through Generations."
translations.idiomatic: Tang Junyi was prefect and had his residence marked as the Loyal and Upright Ward, taking the bestowed stele inscription "Loyalty and Uprightness Handed Down through Generations."

sentences.zh: 正平告之曰：「此朝廷所賜，施于金石，揭於墓隧，假寵于范氏子孫則可；

translations.literal: Zhengping told him: "This was bestowed by the court and may be set in metal and stone and displayed at the tomb passage, and the Fan clan's descendants may borrow the honor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhengping told him, "This was bestowed by the court and may be set in metal and stone and displayed at the tomb passage, and the Fan clan's descendants may borrow the honor;

sentences.zh: 若於通途廣陌中為往來之觀，以聳動庸俗，不可也。」

translations.literal: but to make it a spectacle for passersby on broad public roads and startle vulgar opinion—that cannot be done."
translations.idiomatic: but to make it a spectacle for passersby on broad public roads and startle vulgar opinion—that cannot be done."

sentences.zh: 君益曰：「此有司之事，君家何預焉？」

translations.literal: Junyi said: "This is the officials' business—what has your family to do with it?"
translations.idiomatic: Junyi said, "This is the officials' business—what has your family to do with it?"

sentences.zh: 正平曰：「先祖先君功名，人所知也。

translations.literal: Zhengping said: "Our ancestors' and our late father's achievements are known to all.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengping said, "Our ancestors' and our late father's achievements are known to all.

sentences.zh: 十室之邑，必有忠信，異時不獨吾家詒笑，君亦受其責矣。」

translations.literal: In a hamlet of ten households there is sure to be loyalty and trust—another time it will not be our family alone that is mocked; you too will bear the blame."
translations.idiomatic: In a hamlet of ten households there is sure to be loyalty and trust—another time it will not be our family alone that is mocked; you too will bear the blame."

sentences.zh: 竟撤去之。

translations.literal: In the end it was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the end it was removed.

sentences.zh: 正平退閑久，益工詩，尤長五言，著《荀裏退居編》，以壽終。

translations.literal: Zhengping lived in retirement for a long time and became more skilled in poetry, especially excelling in five-character verse; he compiled "Collected Writings from Retirement in the Bush" and died at a full age.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengping lived in retirement for a long time and became more skilled in poetry, especially excelling in five-character verse; he compiled "Collected Writings from Retirement in the Bush" and died at a full age.

sentences.zh: 論曰：自古一代帝王之興，必有一代名世之臣。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Since ancient times, whenever an age's emperor arose, there was sure to be an age's eminent minister.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Since ancient times, whenever an age's emperor arose, there was sure to be an age's eminent minister.

sentences.zh: 宋有仲淹諸賢，無愧乎此。

translations.literal: The Song had Zhongyan and the other worthies—none shamed this saying.
translations.idiomatic: The Song had Zhongyan and the other worthies—none shamed this saying.

sentences.zh: 仲淹初在制中，遺宰相書，極論天下事，他日為政，盡行其言。

translations.literal: When Zhongyan was first in mourning he sent the chancellor a letter exhaustively discussing affairs under Heaven; when he later held power he fully carried out what he had said.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongyan was first in mourning he sent the chancellor a letter exhaustively discussing affairs under Heaven; when he later held power he fully carried out what he had said.

sentences.zh: 諸葛孔明草廬始見昭烈數語，生平事業備見於是。

translations.literal: Zhuge Kongming, in his thatched hut at first meeting Xiandi in a few words—his life's work is all seen in this.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuge Kongming, in his thatched hut at first meeting Emperor Zhaolie in a few words—his life's work is all seen in this.

sentences.zh: 豪傑自知之審，類如是乎！

translations.literal: Heroes who know themselves clearly are mostly like this!
translations.idiomatic: Heroes who know themselves clearly are mostly like this!

sentences.zh: 考其當朝，雖不能久，然先憂後樂之志，海內固已信其有弘毅之器，足任斯責，使究其所欲為，豈讓古人哉！」

translations.literal: Examining his time in power, though he could not long remain, yet his resolve to worry first and rejoice after was already trusted throughout the realm to show he had the firm and resolute capacity sufficient for this charge—had he fully accomplished what he wished to do, how would he yield to the men of old!
translations.idiomatic: Examining his time in power, though he could not long remain, yet his resolve to worry first and rejoice after was already trusted throughout the realm to show he had the firm and resolute capacity sufficient for this charge—had he fully accomplished what he wished to do, how would he yield to the men of old!

sentences.zh: 純仁位過其父，而幾有父風。

translations.literal: Chunren's rank surpassed his father's, yet he nearly had his father's manner.
translations.idiomatic: Chunren's rank surpassed his father's, yet he nearly had his father's manner.

sentences.zh: 元祐建議攻熙、豐太急，純仁救蔡確一事，所謂謀國甚遠，當世若從其言，元祐黨錮之禍，不至若是烈也。

translations.literal: In Yuanyou the attack on the Xi and Feng reforms was too hasty; in Chunren's effort to save Cai Que in one matter—what is called planning for the state from far off—if his contemporaries had followed his words, the Yuanyou faction-ban calamity would not have been so fierce.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou the attack on the Xi and Feng reforms was too hasty; in Chunren's effort to save Cai Que in one matter—what is called planning for the state from far off—if his contemporaries had followed his words, the Yuanyou faction-ban calamity would not have been so fierce.

sentences.zh: 仲淹謂諸子，純仁得其忠，純禮得其靜，純粹得其略。

translations.literal: Zhongyan told his sons: Chunren received his loyalty, Chun Li received his calm, Chun Cui received his breadth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan told his sons: Chunren received his loyalty, Chun Li received his calm, Chun Cui received his breadth.

sentences.zh: 知子孰與父哉！

translations.literal: Who knows a son better than a father!
translations.idiomatic: Who knows a son better than a father!
